Original science fiction 2D side-scrolling tactical game environment art. Clean painted hard-surface illustration, restrained gunmetal navy and cool cyan lighting with small amber accents, readable large shapes, realistic material detail. No people, no characters, no weapons, no writing, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Orthographic side elevation, no isometric camera.
Wide panoramic deep space orbital station exterior background. A luminous blue planet limb fills the bottom right third; black navy starfield with sparse stars above. Distant enormous orbital ring and a few small suspended satellite modules toward the edges. Very distant subdued detail, broad dark clear negative space in the middle for gameplay silhouettes. No foreground floor, no staircases, no terrain, no mountains, no desert. Full bleed landscape.
